firstPrinciples: At the first-principles level, this reflects fundamental conservation laws (energy, momentum, and quantum information).
whatIf: What if gravitational equilibrium in three-body orbital systems were weakened by an order of magnitude? The equilibrium of lagrange points would collapse.
realLife: Practical application: Understanding this principle directly powers advances in James Webb Space Telescope L2 orbit.
